papers.name: MedRAX
papers.protocol: 2500 six-option questions; GPT-4o backbone; specialized VQA and grounding tools; extract answer letters and retry invalid answers up to three times.
papers.local_gap: 12 sampled patients; local Qwen3-VL NF4; full clinical JSON report; tools and benchmark interface differ.

papers.name: MedAgent-Pro
papers.protocol: GPT-4o backbone; 442 chest X-ray cases from 100 patients; up to 12 thoracic conditions/abnormalities; bAcc and F1.
papers.local_gap: Rare-disease free diagnosis and six-option MCQ accuracy are not the same metric.

paper_described_knowledge_base.retrieval: summary keyword filtering then top-five vector-retrieved chunks

papers.name: CXRAgent
papers.method: Validate individual tool statements against original image before downstream diagnosis; route collaboration by case difficulty.
papers.local_application_inference: Prioritize tool-claim verification and preserve an independent original-image baseline; do not make tool normality reports ground truth.

papers.name: Lingshu
papers.comparison_note: These are different medical VQA datasets, not ChestAgentBench, and the comparator is Qwen2.5-VL, not our Qwen3-VL.

papers.name: Emergency_department_CXR_external_evaluation
papers.method: 478 patients; same-day CXR and CT; blinded thoracic-radiologist report review; CT-based finding-level evaluation.
papers.finding: Medical VLM performance varies by finding; model-card task accuracy is not a guarantee of clinical CXR sensitivity.

confirmed_local_problems: Six of twelve Agent tasks did not produce a valid letter in the frozen baseline (two failures, four null choices).
Image observations classified an abnormal mediastinum as normal in case17056.
Corpus contains only eleven documents and does not cover the rare diagnoses represented in the sample.
